§3§lBirthdays and anniversaries§r
Set your birthday in the sign-in tab using MM-dd, and add up to §15§r custom anniversaries. Administrators maintain festival and blessing templates. The default birthday mail includes a §2cake§r.

§3§lLunar festivals and solar terms§r
Lunar festivals are converted automatically to that year's dates; §clunar leap months do not trigger them§r. The system also sends mail for §111§r key solar terms, with seasonal crop attachments. Servers can configure the contents.

§3§lCompletion§r
Read the blessing-mail and date-setting instructions, then tick the checkbox. Setting a birthday or receiving mail is not required.
